description: This file defines functions and classes related to managing alternative network services, including protocol validation, histogram logging, and processing alternative service entries for protocols like HTTP/2 and QUIC within the Chromium project.

classes.name: AlternativeServiceInfo
classes.description: Represents information about an alternative network service, including protocol, expiration, and associated versions.

classes.name: AlternativeService
classes.description: Represents an alternative network service with protocol, host, and port.

methods.name: HistogramAlternateProtocolUsage
methods.description: Logs usage statistics for alternate protocols, distinguishing Google hosts.

methods.name: HistogramBrokenAlternateProtocolLocation
methods.description: Logs locations where broken alternate protocols are detected.

methods.name: IsAlternateProtocolValid
methods.description: Checks if a given protocol is valid for use as an alternate protocol.

methods.name: IsProtocolEnabled
methods.description: Determines if a protocol is enabled based on feature flags.

methods.name: AlternativeServiceInfo::CreateHttp2AlternativeServiceInfo
methods.description: Creates an AlternativeServiceInfo object for HTTP/2.

methods.name: AlternativeServiceInfo::CreateQuicAlternativeServiceInfo
methods.description: Creates an AlternativeServiceInfo object for QUIC.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs an AlternativeService object to a stream.

methods.name: ProcessAlternativeServices
methods.description: Converts a list of SPDY alternative service entries into internal AlternativeServiceInfo objects, filtering and processing based on protocol validity and feature flags.
